protocols.name: Pyth Core

protocols.name: Pyth Pro

protocols.name: AlphaFi Lending
protocols.methodology: Share of borrow interest and liquidation fees kept by the AlphaFi protocol.

protocols.name: Megamine
protocols.methodology: All retained ETH is protocol revenue.

protocols.name: PigeonHouse
protocols.methodology: 0.5% treasury revenue from each trade.

protocols.name: HyperSwap Terminal
protocols.methodology: Net protocol revenue after referral payouts.

protocols.name: MineLoot
protocols.methodology: All extracted fees (admin + vault) are protocol revenue.

protocols.name: Edel
protocols.methodology: Percentage of interest going to treasury

protocols.name: Grove Finance
protocols.methodology: No revenue

protocols.name: Treble V2
protocols.methodology: Protocol has no revenue.

protocols.name: Lista DEX
protocols.methodology: Lista DAO takes a portion of swap fees.

protocols.name: AirNFTs
protocols.methodology: The protocol takes a 2.5% cut from the seller on all transactions

protocols.name: NFPrompt
protocols.methodology: The protocol takes a 2.5% cut from the seller on all transactions

protocols.name: Holoworld AI
protocols.methodology: 70% of fees go to the protocol fee collector.

protocols.name: flip by Spaace
protocols.methodology: All the fees are revenue

protocols.name: Saphyre RFQ
protocols.methodology: All fees are protocol revenue (no LPs in RFQ model).

protocols.name: Xpert
protocols.methodology: Protocol and holders share of interest

protocols.name: Flying Tulip Lend
protocols.methodology: Leverage trading fees and RFQ liquidation fees flow to the Flying Tulip treasury via feeCollector and liqFeeCollector. Borrower interest does not retain a protocol cut on chain.

protocols.name: Kyan Blue Perps
protocols.methodology: Treasury and token holders revenue

protocols.name: LayerZero V1
protocols.methodology: ZRO protocol fees moved from UltraLightNodeV2 to the LayerZero V1 Treasury contract via WithdrawZRO. Historically the V1 protocol take rate has been ~0, so this value is typically negligible. Tokens flow to the Foundation treasury and are not burnt by the contract.

protocols.name: Veax Perps
protocols.methodology: All builder fees collected by VEAX.

protocols.name: Land Bid
protocols.methodology: For V2, includes protocol revenue plus holders revenue, equal to 15% of Conquer.price and LP fees earned by protocol-owned/locked Uniswap V3 liquidity. Historical V1 revenue is kept under the previous adapter methodology.

protocols.name: Tigris Mezo V3
protocols.methodology: No protocol revenue.

protocols.name: Yeet BGT Auction
protocols.methodology: Protocol treasury + YEET buyback portion of auction bids.

protocols.name: Reental
protocols.methodology: The upfront subscription or offering fee retained by Reental or the issuer/manager for structuring, coordination, operational oversight, and investor onboarding services.

protocols.name: Sky Money
protocols.methodology: Yields are collected by curators.

protocols.name: DoubleZero Edge
protocols.methodology: 10% of Edge revenue is burned in 2Z for protocol security.

protocols.name: Huma
protocols.methodology: Zero — the permissionless pool has no protocol fee configured; all PayFi yield flows to LPs.

protocols.name: hodl.dance
protocols.methodology: 1% platform fee from every buy/sell transaction in BondingCurve contracts

protocols.name: Kaskad
protocols.methodology: Percentage of interest going to treasury

protocols.name: Mercury
protocols.methodology: All extracted fees: the admin fee accrues to the team treasury and the vault fee accrues to MRCY holders via the buyback. There is no LP/supply-side cut, so Revenue equals Fees.

protocols.name: FanVibe
protocols.methodology: Protocol revenue equals the 0.5% accepted-stake fee retained by FanVibe.

protocols.name: Velkonix
protocols.methodology: Percentage of interest going to treasury

protocols.name: Onyx Perps
protocols.methodology: Builder code revenue from Hyperliquid Perps Trades.

protocols.name: Kaito Capital Launchpad
protocols.methodology: All launchpad fees collected by Kaito (2.5% USDC + 2.5% project tokens).

protocols.name: PEPTIDES
protocols.methodology: Includes 90% of revenue retained for PEPTIDES store and 10% allocated to the $PEPTIDES buyback program.

protocols.name: FrothSwap
protocols.methodology: 0.50% of swap fees are used to buy back and burn FROTH.

protocols.name: Based Alpha
protocols.methodology: Protocol share of trade fees (0.95% of each trade) plus migration fees.

protocols.name: Catnip
protocols.methodology: Percentage of swap fees going to treasury and/or token holders

protocols.name: IMF
protocols.methodology: Protocol share of trading fees (0.95% of trade value via FeesAccrued) plus graduation and creation fees.

protocols.name: Peeps
protocols.methodology: 0.85% platform fee from every bonding-curve trade, allocated to the PEEPS.WTF platform and ecosystem.

protocols.name: HoodMint
protocols.methodology: The protocol slice of the bonding-curve trade fee.

protocols.name: Morpho Midnight
protocols.methodology: Protocol fees kept by Morpho: the settlement fee (taker-paid spread on each trade) plus the continuous fee accrued on new lender credit. Both are disabled at launch, so Revenue is currently 0.

protocols.name: MinePea
protocols.methodology: All extracted fees: the sum of protocol revenue (admin fees) and holders revenue (vault fees).

protocols.name: Robhood
protocols.methodology: All staker rewards — the ETH distributed to veNFT stakers (RewardDistributed events on CashVoteEscrowStaking).

protocols.name: Orchard
protocols.methodology: Gross profit: the admin fee plus the stakers and treasury cuts of the rake. The jackpot cut is excluded because it is paid back out to players.

protocols.name: LUNA
protocols.methodology: ETH distributed to LUNA stakers plus the protocol's retained cut.

protocols.name: Lista Pre-IPO
protocols.methodology: All pre-IPO income is collected by Lista DAO.

protocols.name: ROAR
protocols.methodology: Fees retained by Roar or accruing to ROAR holders through treasury buybacks and permanent dead-address transfers. AutoMiner execution fees are excluded from revenue because they are paid to third-party executors.

protocols.name: LFJ POE
protocols.methodology: POE takes no protocol fee share.

protocols.name: MINER
protocols.methodology: A flat 5000-lamport fee on every Mine instruction plus 5% of every collapsed Caves game pot (SOL side), both paid to the protocol fee wallet.

protocols.name: prism
protocols.methodology: The protocol's share of each finalised lease, currently 10% of the amount charged.

protocols.name: Wise Token
protocols.methodology: The pool is ownerless (no admin/team fee switch), so no portion of swap fees is retained as protocol revenue.

protocols.name: Rujira Trade
protocols.methodology: The Rujira share of FIN fees, the full RUJI Swap affiliate fee, and the 10% bRUNE protocol commission for the covered products.

protocols.name: Fake Wall Street
protocols.methodology: Protocol cut of pack fees, redemption-fee skims and zap fees, all accruing to the treasury.

protocols.name: Robin Labs
protocols.methodology: The protocol's share of trading fees, including the portion deferred until a coin graduates and the 25% treasury cut of above-default fee tiers, plus the protocol's graduation reward.

protocols.name: BidGrid
protocols.methodology: Gross profit from BidGrid round fees after excluding the jackpot amount paid back to winning miners.

protocols.name: Robin
protocols.methodology: Same as fees: 100% of registration and renewal costs accrue to the protocol treasury (a 2-of-3 Safe). There are no third-party fee splits.

protocols.name: Loopr
protocols.methodology: Loopr's 30% cut of each basket's mint fee, the LOOPR token creator + protocol tax paid to Loopr's own wallet, and ETH deposited into Loopr's community vault.

protocols.name: Aero Lite
protocols.methodology: Zero: no Voter/veAERO gauge system is deployed on Arc yet, so no fees are redirected away from LPs.

protocols.name: vibes.fun
protocols.methodology: 30% of fees: the share vibes.fun keeps, split between its treasury and $VIBES buyback and burn.

protocols.name: REP369
protocols.methodology: REP369 tax allocated to REP holder rewards plus the sell-side burn allocation. Automatic liquidity is treated as supply-side revenue.

protocols.name: DaWabLauncher
protocols.methodology: All DaWabLauncher bonding-curve trading fees are retained as protocol revenue.

protocols.name: StonkBrokers Broker Box
protocols.methodology: Broker Box protocol accrual (5% of ticket) + sell-back spread + the treasury half of the Certificate Counter fee.

protocols.name: Kiltr
protocols.methodology: Protocol share of swap fees (ProtocolFeesCollector / ProtocolFeeController percentage read live from kiltr.net/api/fees).

protocols.name: Archery V2
protocols.methodology: V2 swap fees routed to veArchery voters through gauges, equal to HoldersRevenue.

protocols.name: Hypercall Perps
protocols.methodology: Builder code fees collected by Hypercall on those trades.

protocols.name: EL Casino Rooms
protocols.methodology: The platform fee, sent to the ElcasTreasury.

protocols.name: EL Perps
protocols.methodology: The platform's share of open and close fees (currently 10 %), accrued for the platform's fee address.

protocols.name: EL Predict
protocols.methodology: The platform's share of each round's fee (currently 1 % of the losing side).

protocols.name: Lista CDP
protocols.methodology: Collected income kept by the protocol, net of the sLisUSD savings interest paid out to sLisUSD depositors.

protocols.name: Limitless Exchange
protocols.methodology: Trading fees left over after the daily payouts to makers, liquidity providers and market creators

protocols.name: Hegic
protocols.methodology: The same as Fees, the Stake & Cover pool keeps all of its net premiums.

protocols.name: Azuro
protocols.methodology: Total pools profits (equals total bets amount minus total won bets amount)
